fields.name: session_kind
fields.doc: What an SFU session is for: a Participant's connection or the recorder's receive-only capture connection.

fields.name: recording_session_outcome
fields.doc: The SFU session's closing outcome, as the node journaled it.

fields.name: recording_session_cause
fields.doc: The SFU node's own word for why a session closed, such as closed or connection_failed.

fields.name: recording_media_kind
fields.doc: Which medium a publication, ingress or egress row counts.

fields.name: recording_media_source
fields.doc: The published track's source name as the SFU journaled it, such as microphone or screen.

fields.name: recording_packets
fields.doc: Packets the SFU counted on a session's ingress since it connected.

fields.name: recording_sent_audio
fields.doc: Audio packets the SFU sent on a session's downlink since it connected.

fields.name: recording_sent_video
fields.doc: Video packets the SFU sent on a session's downlink since it connected.

fields.name: recording_final
fields.doc: Whether a journaled SFU or recorder row is the terminal one for its session or attempt.

fields.name: capture_packet_count
fields.doc: Media packets a capture attempt counted itself: the recorder's own number, not the SFU's.

fields.name: capture_track_count
fields.doc: Tracks a capture attempt held when it finished.

fields.name: stop_cause
fields.doc: The bounded word a capture attempt gives for why it stopped.

fields.name: recording_capture_outcome
fields.doc: How a capture attempt or its recovered lease ended, from the recorder's summary or the API's recovery line.

fields.name: recording_job_state
fields.doc: A recording_jobs row's state.

fields.name: recording_job_kind
fields.doc: Which kind of recording job the row is.

fields.name: recording_error_code
fields.doc: The bounded error code a job, Recording or Sync recording failure carries, sanitized upstream.

fields.name: recording_error_detail
fields.doc: The bounded diagnostic detail a failed attempt logged, already sanitized upstream.

fields.name: recording_attempt_count
fields.doc: Attempts a recording job has spent.

fields.name: recording_attempt_limit
fields.doc: The most attempts a recording job may spend.

fields.name: recording_attempt
fields.doc: The attempt number an attempt-failure row names.

fields.name: recording_available_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of a job's available_at.

fields.name: recording_lease_expiry_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of a job's lease_expires_at, when it was leased.

fields.name: recording_created_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of a row's created_at.

fields.name: recording_updated_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of a row's updated_at.

fields.name: recording_terminal_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of a job's terminal_at.

fields.name: recording_failed_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of an attempt failure's failed_at or a Recording's failed_at.

fields.name: recording_claim_lag_ms
fields.doc: Milliseconds between a capture job's available_at and its recording.claimed row, as the claim transaction journaled it.

fields.name: recording_placement
fields.doc: Where a claimed capture job was placed: the colocated recorder or the recorder fleet.

fields.name: recording_pipeline_state
fields.doc: A recording_pipelines row's state.

fields.name: recording_reservation_state
fields.doc: A recording_reservations row's state.

fields.name: recording_state
fields.doc: A recordings row's status.

fields.name: recording_exists
fields.doc: Whether the item's Recording row exists at all.

fields.name: recording_stop_requested_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of the pipeline's stop_requested_at.

fields.name: recording_capture_completed_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of the pipeline's capture_completed_at.

fields.name: recording_committed_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of the pipeline's committed_at or the artifact's committed_at.

fields.name: recording_completed_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of the Recording's completed_at.

fields.name: recording_media_bundles
fields.doc: Media bundle count the capture committed to the pipeline.

fields.name: recording_gap_bundles
fields.doc: Gap bundle count the capture committed to the pipeline.

fields.name: recording_capture_completeness
fields.doc: Whether the capture's bundle account is whole or has proven gaps.

fields.name: recording_reservation_starts_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of the reservation's starts_at, when capture actually began.

fields.name: recording_reservation_ends_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of the reservation's ends_at.

fields.name: recording_sync_status
fields.doc: A sync_recordings row's status: what Sync believes the Recording's lifecycle is.

fields.name: recording_episode_ended_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of the Episode's ended_at, from its durable row.

fields.name: recording_media_plane
fields.doc: The media plane the Episode's config snapshot names, such as chalk_sfu.

fields.name: recording_artifact_set
fields.doc: Whether the item's durable artifact row or storage key exists.

fields.name: recording_size_bytes
fields.doc: A stored object's byte size, durable or measured.

fields.name: recording_sha_set
fields.doc: Whether a checksum is committed for a stored object.

fields.name: recording_sha_match
fields.doc: Whether a stored object's measured checksum matches its committed one.

fields.name: recording_storage_match
fields.doc: Whether the artifact row's object key is the one the Recording row names.

fields.name: recording_duration_ms
fields.doc: The committed media duration of a Recording or its artifact.

fields.name: recording_expires_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds of the artifact row's expires_at, when retention applies.

fields.name: recording_r2_result
fields.doc: The outcome of the checker's object readback: key, size, checksum, probe and decode against the committed row.

fields.name: recording_head_result
fields.doc: The outcome of a HEAD on one committed bundle object.

fields.name: recording_probe_duration_ms
fields.doc: The media duration ffprobe measured on the stored object.

fields.name: recording_bundle_sequence
fields.doc: A committed bundle's sequence_number within its Recording.

fields.name: journey_name
fields.doc: The observability_journey_events name a durable journey row carries, such as recording.claimed.

fields.name: recording_fleet_operation
fields.doc: The recorder-fleet controller operation a failure row names, such as bootstrap or issue.

fields.name: player_id
fields.doc: An opaque id minted per dashboard playback so one viewer's facts are one session's.

fields.name: media_error_code
fields.doc: The MediaError.code a <video> element raised: 1 aborted, 2 network, 3 decode, 4 src_not_supported.

fields.name: can_play_mp4
fields.doc: What canPlayType(video/mp4) answered in the reporting browser.

fields.name: url_age_ms
fields.doc: Milliseconds between the URL's mint and the playback fact that cites it.

fields.name: url_lifetime_ms
fields.doc: The signed lifetime the URL was minted with.

fields.name: mint_count
fields.doc: How many URLs the reporting player minted for this Recording.

fields.name: playback_signed_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds the URL was minted.

fields.name: playback_expires_ms
fields.doc: Unix epoch milliseconds the URL expires.

fields.name: playback_download
fields.doc: Whether the minted URL carries the download disposition.

fields.name: recording_stage
fields.doc: The render stage a stage op measured, such as download_capture or upload.

fields.name: recording_media_action
fields.doc: Which media action a client media_result row reports.

fields.name: recording_media_outcome
fields.doc: The outcome a client media_result row reports.

fields.name: playback_progress_ms
fields.doc: How far into the Recording the dashboard player had reached at the report.

events.name: recording.start
events.doc: Sync's durable acceptance of a Participant's recording request for the Episode.

events.name: recording.status_failed
events.doc: Sync's durable write of the Recording's status=failed with its bounded failure code.

events.name: recording.capture_claim
events.doc: The API's capture claim, after the lease commits: who the job went to, its attempt and the claim lag the journey row carried.

events.name: recording.capture_empty
events.doc: The API's terminal empty-capture decision: the attempt finished reporting success but committed no media bundles.

events.name: recording.reservation_expired
events.doc: The API's reservation-expiry decision: the Recording's capacity window lapsed before a claim. The existing log line stays.

events.name: recording.capture_attempt
events.doc: One capture attempt's Run from claim to terminal: ok, expected(recording.media_stopped|recording.deadline) or error(recording.<code>).

events.name: recording.render_stage
events.doc: One measured render stage per RecordingRenderAttempt.measure call; the stage name is the hop the stage code names.

events.name: recording.capture_finished
events.doc: The recorder's own summary of what a capture saw: outcome, track count, packet count and the stop cause.

events.name: recording.capture_attempt_failed
events.doc: The API's journal of one failed capture attempt, with its bounded error code, when the worker's Fail report commits.

events.name: recording.render_attempt_failed
events.doc: The API's journal of one failed render attempt, with its stage-scoped error code, when the worker's Fail report commits.

events.name: recording.job_recovered
events.doc: The API's recovery decision for one leased job whose worker went silent: requeued or terminal with its error code.

events.name: recorder_fleet.operation_failed
events.doc: A recorder-fleet controller operation that failed, journaled by the API: bootstrap, issue or heartbeat.

events.name: recording.media_publish
events.doc: A client's media_result publish row: the Participant's own account that it published media.

events.name: sfu.session.registered
events.doc: The SFU node's journal of one session's registration, capture or participant, with its connection.

events.name: sfu.session.closed
events.doc: The SFU node's journal of one session's close: its outcome, cause and lifetime.

events.name: sfu.publication.started
events.doc: The SFU node's journal of one track's publication on a participant session.

events.name: sfu.media.ingress
events.doc: The SFU node's periodic or final count of packets received on one session's publication.

events.name: sfu.media.transport
events.doc: The SFU node's periodic or final count of packets it sent on one session's downlink; on a capture session this is the media the recorder was handed.

events.name: playback.url_minted
events.doc: The API's mint of one download URL for a committed Recording: its signed and expiry times, never the signed URL itself.

events.name: playback.media_error
events.doc: The dashboard player's report of a MediaError on one playback session, with the URL's age and the browser's MP4 answer. Emitted only after the server's ownership check.

events.name: playback.progressed
events.doc: The dashboard player's report that one playback session actually advanced past two seconds while playing. Emitted only after the server's ownership check.

events.name: playback.player_error_note
events.doc: The error note the dashboard player shows a viewer when playback fails.

events.name: recording.db.job
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's recording_jobs row. Emitted by the evidence reader, never a program.

events.name: recording.db.pipeline
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's recording_pipelines row: state, capture counters, completeness and its clock fields.

events.name: recording.db.recording
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's recordings row: status, failure code, storage presence and its clock fields. recording_exists false means no row.

events.name: recording.db.reservation
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's recording_reservations row: its state and window.

events.name: recording.db.journey
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's durable journey rows for recording.claimed, recording.capture.salvaged and recording.failed, with the attributes the transaction wrote.

events.name: recording.db.attempt
events.doc: The checker's read of one recording_job_attempt_failures row: the durable account of an attempt that failed.

events.name: recording.db.artifact
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's recording_artifacts row, plus whether its object key is the Recording's storage key.

events.name: recording.db.episode
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's Episode row: when it ended and the media plane its config snapshot names.

events.name: recording.db.sync_recording
events.doc: The checker's read of the item's sync_recordings row: what Sync believes the Recording's lifecycle is.

events.name: recording.artifact_readback
events.doc: The checker's R2 readback of the item's committed object: HEAD, ffprobe and a null-muxer decode, with results and measured fields only. The object key, signed URL and headers are never emitted.

events.name: recording.r2.bundle_head
events.doc: The checker's HEAD on one committed bundle object, for the render download stage. The object key is never emitted.

reasons.doc: The capture ended because the Episode's media stopped: the recorder's own stop cause.
The capture ended because its deadline expired.
The Episode ended or a stop landed before the reservation was ever claimed: nobody is at fault.
Nobody published media for the window, so an empty Recording is expected.
The Recording was deleted by retention: a 404 or absent readback is expected.
The render could not download a capture bundle because its retention expired before the render ran.
The browser answered that it cannot play MP4: a src_not_supported error is expected there.
A capture attempt failed for a cause the recorder could not narrow further.
A capture attempt failed connecting or holding its SFU session.
A capture or render attempt failed against object storage.
An attempt failed against its lease or fencing.

machines.name: recording.job
machines.doc: One recording_jobs row's lifecycle. The API writes its transitions after the SQL commits.

facts.name: recording.job_state
facts.doc: The item's recording_jobs row: its state, error code, attempts, lease and clock fields. Claim: its state.

facts.name: recording.pipeline
facts.doc: The item's recording_pipelines row: pipeline state, capture counters, completeness and clock fields.

facts.name: recording.row
facts.doc: The item's recordings row: status, failure code, storage presence and clock fields; recording_exists false means none.

facts.name: recording.reservation
facts.doc: The item's recording_reservations row: its state and the window it reserved.

facts.name: recording.sync
facts.doc: The item's sync_recordings row: what Sync believes the Recording's lifecycle is.

facts.name: recording.episode
facts.doc: The item's Episode row: when it ended and the media plane its config snapshot names.

facts.name: recording.claim
facts.doc: One claim, salvage or terminal-failure durable journey row for the item, or the API's claim decision. Claim: the journey name, or claimed.

facts.name: recording.attempts
facts.doc: One durable attempt-failure row or API attempt-failure journal line for the item.

facts.name: recording.capture_transport
facts.doc: One SFU transport count for the item's capture session; sent_audio + sent_video is the media the node handed the recorder.

facts.name: recording.participant_ingress
facts.doc: One SFU ingress count for a participant session's publication in the item's Episode.

facts.name: recording.session_close
facts.doc: One SFU session-close journal row in the item's Episode.

facts.name: recording.session_register
facts.doc: One SFU session-registration journal row in the item's Episode; the node reporting every participant session is what makes 'no publications' proven.

facts.name: recording.publication
facts.doc: One SFU publication-start journal row in the item's Episode.

facts.name: recording.capture_result
facts.doc: The recorder's own account of the item's capture: its summary line or the attempt op's terminal.

facts.name: recording.render_result
facts.doc: One render stage op for the item, or the API's journal of a failed render attempt.

facts.name: recording.media_publish
facts.doc: A client's media_result publish row in the item's Episode: a Participant's own account that it published.

facts.name: recording.fleet
facts.doc: The API's journal of a recorder-fleet operation failure in the item's window.

facts.name: recording.artifact
facts.doc: The item's recording_artifacts row and whether its object key is the Recording's storage key.

facts.name: recording.object
facts.doc: The checker's R2 readback of the item's committed object: key, size, checksum, probe and decode. Claim: its result.

facts.name: recording.bundle_head
facts.doc: The checker's HEAD on one committed bundle object, for the render download stage.

facts.name: playback.url
facts.doc: One download URL the API minted for the item's Recording.

facts.name: playback.error
facts.doc: One dashboard player's report of a MediaError on the item's Recording.

facts.name: playback.progress
facts.doc: One dashboard player's report that playback actually advanced on the item's Recording.

facts.name: playback.note
facts.doc: The error note the dashboard player showed a viewer on the item's Recording.

symptoms.doc: An ended Episode's Recording never became ready to watch.

witnesses.query: postgres: select state, updated_at from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: Whether and how the export job ended.

symptoms.doc: A capture job nobody ever ran: attempt_count=0, no claim row, and it died of reservation expiry or stop-before-completion.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The job row: state, error code, attempt count and clock fields.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from observability_journey_events where name = 'recording.claimed' and attributes->>'job_id' = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The durable claim row, or its proven absence.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_reservations where recording_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The reservation: expired or released, and its window.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_pipelines where recording_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: Stop request and capture progress the pipeline recorded.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recordings where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The Recording row's status, failure code and created_at.

witnesses.query: postgres: select ended_at, config_snapshot from episodes where id = '{episode}'
witnesses.doc: When the Episode ended.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from sync_recordings where recording_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: What Sync believes happened.

witnesses.query: grep recorder_fleet.operation_failed api.log
witnesses.doc: A fleet operation failure near the job names recorder.fleet instead of api.recording_pipeline.

witnesses.query: grep sfu.session.closed journal | grep {episode}
witnesses.doc: An SFU close before the claim names the cause.

symptoms.doc: A capture the db says was claimed, with a provably missing span: claim lag past the bound, a failed attempt followed by a later claim, or capture completeness partial.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: Attempts and the job's clock fields.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from observability_journey_events where name = 'recording.claimed' and attributes->>'job_id' = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The durable claim rows and their claim lag.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_job_attempt_failures where job_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The durable account of attempts that failed.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_pipelines where recording_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: Completeness and the capture counters.

witnesses.query: grep sfu.media.transport journal | grep capture | grep {episode}
witnesses.doc: The capture session's sent counters bound the span.

witnesses.query: grep recording.capture_finished recorder.log | grep {job}
witnesses.doc: The recorder's own account bounds the span too.

symptoms.doc: A capture job that spent at least one attempt and ended terminal_failure for any cause but capture_empty.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: Terminal failure, its error code and the attempts spent.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_job_attempt_failures where job_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The durable per-attempt failure account.

witnesses.query: grep recording.capture_finished recorder.log | grep {job}
witnesses.doc: The recorder's own account; a lease that expired with no capture_finished names a worker that disappeared.

witnesses.query: grep sfu.session.closed journal | grep capture | grep {episode}
witnesses.doc: The capture session's close cause corroborates.

symptoms.doc: A capture that reported success with no media committed. Broken unless the SFU and the clients prove nobody published.
user_words: the recording has nothing in it

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: capture_empty error code and the attempt count.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_pipelines where recording_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: Media and gap bundle counts.

witnesses.query: grep sfu.media.transport journal | grep capture | grep {episode}
witnesses.doc: Whether the node handed the recorder media.

witnesses.query: grep sfu.media.ingress journal | grep {episode}
witnesses.doc: Whether the node ever received media.

witnesses.query: grep sfu.session.registered journal | grep {episode}
witnesses.doc: The node reporting every participant session makes absent publications proven.

witnesses.query: grep sfu.publication.started journal | grep {episode}
witnesses.doc: Any participant publication, or its proven absence.

witnesses.query: grep media_result api rows | grep publish
witnesses.doc: A Participant's own account that it published.

witnesses.query: grep recording.capture_finished recorder.log | grep {job}
witnesses.doc: The recorder's packet count corroborates.

symptoms.doc: A capture job pending 15 minutes after availability, or a capture or export state unmoving past its bound.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: State, lease expiry, attempts and clock fields.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_pipelines where recording_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The pipeline state and when it last moved.

witnesses.query: postgres: select ended_at from episodes where id = '{episode}'
witnesses.doc: The Episode's end bounds every stuck window.

symptoms.doc: A render attempt that failed: the stage code names the hop, and a bundle 404 on download_capture names storage.r2.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The terminal failure and its stage-scoped error code.

witnesses.query: grep recording.render_stage recorder.log | grep {job}
witnesses.doc: The render stage rows name the failing stage themselves.

witnesses.query: HEAD each recording_bundles.object_key for '{job}'
witnesses.doc: A bundle 404 during download_capture names storage.r2; without it the stage says where it failed.

symptoms.doc: A committed export whose stored object cannot be read back: wrong key, 404, wrong size or checksum, no video, bad duration or undecodable.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_jobs where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The export job's committed outcome.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_artifacts where recording_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The durable object account: key match, size, checksum, duration and expiry.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recordings where id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: The Recording's storage key, status and completed_at.

witnesses.query: postgres: select * from recording_pipelines where recording_id = '{job}'
witnesses.doc: A deleted pipeline means retention, which expects the absence.

witnesses.query: readback '{job}' via CHALK_R2_READ_*
witnesses.doc: The object read back and measured; the only proof it is readable.

symptoms.doc: A dashboard playback failed on a URL older than its signed lifetime.

witnesses.query: grep playback.url_minted api.log | grep {job}
witnesses.doc: The API's mint of the URL and its signed lifetime.

witnesses.query: grep playback.media_error api rows | grep {job}
witnesses.doc: The player's report with the URL's age at failure.

symptoms.doc: A dashboard playback failed inside the URL's lifetime: decode when the browser can play MP4, or a network abort past expiry.

witnesses.query: grep playback.media_error api rows | grep {job}
witnesses.doc: The player's MediaError report.

witnesses.query: grep playback.player_error_note api rows | grep {job}
witnesses.doc: The note the player showed the viewer.

witnesses.query: readback '{job}' via CHALK_R2_READ_*
witnesses.doc: The readback decides whether the player or the object is at fault.
